div.head: III Eg 2.1
div.ab: Gyf þæt riht to hefig sy, sece siþþan ða lihtinge to þam cynge.
Gyf þæt riht to hefig sy, sece syððan þa lyhtinge to þam cynge.
Si rectum graue nimis est, postea querat inde ueniam apud regem.
Gif þæt riht to hefig sy, secan siððan þa lihtinge to þam cynge.
Gyf þæt riht to hefig sy, sece siþþan ða lihtinge to þam cynge.
If the law is too oppressive, he shall apply to the king for mitigation.
If the law is too harsh, let him petition the king for mitigation.
If that law is too severe, he is then to apply to the king for alleviation.
Wenn das [Land]recht zu streng ist, heische er (-en sie D) dann die Erleichterung vom König.
If the [law of the land] is too severe, let him (them, D) then seek relief from the king.
